instrument: Virginia SCC Final Order, Case No. PUR-2025-00058
summary: Directs Dominion to file its new large-load interconnection queue process, with testimony, in a separate formal proceeding on or before February 2, 2026, and encourages faster interconnection for loads meeting readiness criteria such as site readiness, proximity to generation, and flexibility.
text: the Commission further directs that the Company file its new large load interconnection queue process, along with supporting testimony, in a separate future proceeding at the Commission. The Commission finds that the public interest would be supported by a transparent process wherein the rules for the interconnection process of larger loads are subject to examination and approval in a formal proceeding. [...] The Commission anticipates that such a proceeding will occur on an expedited timeline and directs that the Company make such a filing on or before February 2, 2026.

source.citation: Virginia State Corporation Commission, Final Order, Case No. PUR-2025-00058, Application of Virginia Electric and Power Company for a 2025 biennial review, entered November 25, 2025 (Doc. Con. Cen. No. 251140150)

notes: The resulting proceeding is SCC Case No. PUR-2026-00011, filed February 2, 2026 (per PJM and secondary accounts; that docket not read). Refresh when PUR-2026-00011 is decided.
confidence_note: Read in original from the full 28-page order plus attachment, supplied by operator after the SCC site blocked automated retrieval. Document Control Center stamp 11/25/2025 12:14 PM.
